title: Spiral Staircase Bunker
description: A man in an orange hazmat suit stands on a decaying spiral staircase inside a derelict underground bunker, shining a flashlight forward. The concrete walls are covered in posters and warning tape while a large television screen at the bottom displays a nuclear explosion.
prompt: A lone figure in a bright orange hazmat suit with respirator stands on a rusty spiral staircase inside a decaying concrete bunker, holding a flashlight that cuts through the darkness. The walls show peeling paint, old posters, hazard tape, and debris. At the bottom level a large television displays a nuclear mushroom cloud explosion with curtains on either side. Cinematic lighting with overhead fluorescent tubes, eerie atmosphere, detailed textures, painted illustration style.
